E1005

Overflow opt-in not wrapping a single integer op

What

Overflow opt-in not wrapping a single integer op

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E1005

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1005: tests/ui/overflow_optin_misuse.stderr.

Error [E1005]: `wrapping` must wrap a single integer `+`, `-`, `*`, or `/`
  --> tests/ui/overflow_optin_misuse.jet:3:11
    |
  3 |     print(wrapping(x))
    |           ^^^^^^^^
 Why: the overflow opt-ins apply to one arithmetic operation on whole numbers
 Fix: write it around one operation, e.g. `wrapping(a + b)`
